name: Camping Store – API Health Overview
requirements: Create and save a LIVE report with the exact name above, not a chat-only answer or static HTML download.
Use the supplied deployment resources, not names, IDs, endpoints, or telemetry from a previous installation.

Use the read-only system-mcp-monitor_monitor_workspace_log_query tool. Its arguments include subscription, resource-group, workspace, table, query, hours, and limit. Discover/verify the actual tool schema before calling it.

Query AppRequests for request volume, HTTP 5xx count and percentage, and p95 request latency. Show trend charts, a status-code breakdown, and a sortable endpoint breakdown with request count, 5xx rate, and p95 latency.
Query ContainerAppConsoleLogs for recent error log lines. Filter ContainerAppName to the supplied API app. Do not rely on AppExceptions for console errors.
Explain that console logs can arrive several minutes after request telemetry. An empty error-log table does not guarantee there were no errors.
Provide a time-range selector with 1h, 24h, and 7d options. Apply the selection consistently to every query and visualization.

Use a clean operational-dashboard layout with summary metrics, trends, endpoint details, and recent errors. Label units and timestamps. Handle empty telemetry and query failures explicitly; never substitute invented or demonstration measurements.
Use the saved read-only tool for refreshes. Do not use an LLM on refresh, schedule background work, or add write-action buttons.

Do not change resources, roles, permissions, connectors, or tool-approval policy. Only report-authoring tools may save the report; use read-only tools for Azure data. If a prerequisite or approval is missing, explain it in the authoring thread and stop.
Once saved, return the report link. Do not create a second report with the same name.
